column4: ~/proj/prompts/reports/SESSION-REVIEW-AUDITVERIFY-KEYFILES-1.md item 2. Finding KEYFILES-MANIFEST-SHARED-STAGING (low: every write staged as <manifest>.pending, truncated and rewritten in place, so two writers racing past a broken key lock tore the committed manifest, which boot then moved aside and re-adopted; now a unique staging name per write; internal/keyfiles/review_adversarial_test.go:TestReviewKF_InterleavedWriter_DoesNotTouchAnothersStagingFile red on main, :TestReviewKF_RacingWriters_ManifestNeverTorn). The unique name's readers (REVIEW-3810-DEEP-2): ManifestStagingFiles lists every staging file for internal/encryptionops readKeySet, whose key-secret export/generate refusal of an interrupted manifest write had gone dead with the fixed name (internal/encryptionops/key_secret_test.go:TestKeySecret_Refusals interrupted key-set manifest write, staged by the real writer killed at its rename), and ReconcileKeySet removes the leftovers under the exclusive key lock (:TestReviewKF_KilledManifestWrites_ListedThenRemovedAtReconcile). Held: manifest from another generation refused (:TestReviewKF_ManifestFromAnotherGeneration_Refused), torn staging file ignored, symlinked key files hashed through the link with a retargeted link refused and a link to a FIFO refused without blocking (:TestReviewKF_SymlinkedKeyFiles), partial/mixed/incoherent sets and restore's PlanCommit (existing tests). Out of model by design (manifest.go): an actor who can write the key directory, including a key file swapped between check and use. Earlier targeted evidence carried forward (commit 837856e2, PR #1762, 2026-09-06): internal/keyfiles/registry_exhaustiveness_test.go:TestSourceScan_WriteCapableProviderTypesMatchRegistry, TestRegistry_IncludesWrappedKeyPathForEveryWriteCapableType (four hand-copied FilePermSpec lists missing WrappedKeyPath). Not covered: the manifest file itself is not in Registry, so its mode is not checked by admin system audit
